name: dexa-wfh-backend
description: Backend microservices Aplikasi Absensi WFH Dexa (NestJS + MySQL)

scripts.build: nest build auth-service && nest build employee-service && nest build attendance-service && nest build leave-service && nest build api-gateway
scripts.start:dev: concurrently -k -n auth,employee,attendance,leave,gateway -c blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green "nest start auth-service --watch" "nest start employee-service --watch" "nest start attendance-service --watch" "nest start leave-service --watch" "nest start api-gateway --watch"
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -k -n auth,employee,attendance,leave,gateway "node dist/apps/auth-service/main" "node dist/apps/employee-service/main" "node dist/apps/attendance-service/main" "node dist/apps/leave-service/main" "node dist/apps/api-gateway/main"
